note: 单元通关专属迷你阅读(旅行主题,独立短文,不在阅读关出现)。短文2-3句+2题,答案转述非照抄,2题覆盖不同位置。

finalReading.passage: Sara is planning her first trip abroad next month. She is excited, but she is also a little worried because she has never travelled alone before. Her older brother told her that careful planning is the best way to feel safe and enjoy the journey.

questions.q: Why is Sara a little worried about her trip?
options: It is her first time travelling on her own.
She does not like flying at all.
questions.explanation: 原文 she has never travelled alone before 的转述(非照抄);B/C/D 听起来合理但文中没说。

questions.q: What does Sara's brother say will help her most?
options: Taking as little money as possible.
questions.explanation: 原文 careful planning is the best way to feel safe(考短文后半段,覆盖不同位置);其余与原文相反或未提。
